content: Common Vercel-frontend/Render-backend wiring mistakes: (1) CORS_ORIGINS env var missing the https:// scheme so origin match silently fails; (2) frontend build-time env var (VITE_API_URL etc.) not actually set in the hosting dashboard for the right environment, so the built bundle points at localhost or 'undefined'; (3) preview-deployment origins not covered by a static allowlist since Vercel preview URLs are dynamic per-branch; (4) a backend 500/serialization crash masquerading as a CORS error because no response (and thus no CORS headers) is returned at all — always rule out a backend crash before assuming misconfigured CORS; (5) allow_credentials=True combined with allow_origins=['*'] is rejected by browsers/is a security smell — must be an explicit origin list when credentials/auth headers are involved.
